classification.summary: The GoodDollar staking contract's collectInterest() took an unvalidated recipient and called back into it before updating stake accounting, letting the attacker re-enter deposit()/withdraw() and pull the cDAI-backed reserve out as DAI.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: proxy 0x0c6c80d2061afa35e160f3799411d83bdeea0a5a created 2022-03-07T08:26:15Z by 0x3de7216149f12d8f51540d9a870149560fc11bfb, unrelated to the attack sender; three EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2023-09-22T09:25:11Z (block 18190480, implementation 0x4a37a8d7cdb43d89b4dbd7ecfaeaf9bd39e24929), so age runs from that upgrade (85.6 days) rather than from the 2022 deployment.
